gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly so that the interpreter could follow.
Although she was exhausted, she carried on working.
gaps.explanation: despite/in spite of + -ing: despite being exhausted.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.
